scope: Read-only diagnosis of the fixed1895-tree2021 continuation. No retraining, checkpoint selection, editing of model/data, or count retuning.
interpretation: A large negative Newton leaf update is a concrete late-tree regression mechanism. This is not evidence of categorical remapping or source-tree replacement; source prefix/schema are unchanged. The fixed1895 count remains the declared candidate; do not pick an earlier checkpoint retrospectively from these diagnostics.

relevant_facts: min_data_in_leaf/min_child_samples uses a Hessian approximation, so a learned leaf may have fewer observations than the configured minimum. Thus leaf_count27 with min_child_samples100 is not by itself a schema or implementation bug.
max_delta_step limits leaf output, and the effective post-learning-rate cap is learning_rate*max_delta_step.

future_experiment_recommendation.priority: After the already-prepared inexpensive specialist tests, prioritize this targeted mechanism test over extending a broad uninformed tree grid. No implementation or training was performed here.
future_experiment_recommendation.comparison: Same preserved source model, training cohort, features and remaining parameters. Compare the fixed total against both the unmodified1895 continuation and the current winning ensemble; both historical years remain reused.
future_experiment_recommendation.provenance_requirement: Current prepare_continuation rightly disallows parameter changes. A future experiment must explicitly authorize and record the sole old-to-new max_delta_step change, retaining all other provenance guards. Never weaken the entire parameter-match check silently.
future_experiment_recommendation.verification_requirement: Check unchanged source-tree prefix and inspect new-tree leaf outputs to confirm the configured0.5 cap actually applies; check exact final count and full-ensemble performance in both years.

alternative_not_joint_change.rationale: Adds1 to leaf-weight denominator, damping updates when Hessian support is tiny, but also changes split scoring more broadly. Test separately if pursued.

future_experiment_recommendation.rejection_rule: Do not promote on2022 gain alone if the final ensemble regresses2021. Do not select an earlier checkpoint retrospectively from this diagnostic.
